title: Mirabel and the Debt
author: Hazel Galloway
blurb: Elodie Reyes, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, has spent three years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
